title: sublimelsp repositories
description: Repositories of the sublimelsp organization. Each entry only lists values that differ from `defaults`.

defaults.description: Values used for every repository that does not set them.

repos.description: Repositories, keyed by name. Removing an entry archives the repository.

allow_merge_commit.description: Allow merge commits for pull requests.

allow_squash_merge.description: Allow squash merging for pull requests.

allow_rebase_merge.description: Allow rebase merging for pull requests.

allow_update_branch.description: Always suggest updating pull request branches.

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Delete head branches after pull requests are merged.

archived.description: Archive the repository. Unarchiving is not supported by the GitHub API.

protect_default_branch.description: Add the "default branch" ruleset, which blocks deleting and force pushing the default branch. Ignored for archived repositories.

require_linear_history.description: Also require linear history on the default branch.

actions_enabled.description: Enable GitHub Actions. Ignored for archived repositories.

actions_allowed.description: Actions and reusable workflows that may run: `all`, or `local_only` (only the ones in the sublimelsp organization). Ignored when `actions_enabled` is false.

ruleset_bypass_integrations.description: GitHub App IDs that may bypass the default branch ruleset via pull requests.

required_status_checks.description: GitHub Actions check names that must pass before merging into the default branch. Adds the "Require CI" ruleset, which organization owners and repository admins and maintainers can bypass.

collaborators.description: Direct collaborators. Collaborators not listed here are removed.
